deadline.value: Fall applications are due February 15; spring applications are due October 15.
deadline.quote: The application deadline each year is February 15 (for fall admission)

gre_general.value: The GRE aptitude test is typically required and can be waived for outstanding records, but never for international students.
gre_general.quote: Typically, chemistry applicants are required to submit an official report of their performance on the aptitude test from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) | The GRE requirement cannot be waived for international students.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Research is done under the doctoral advisor, but the page does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: The primary objective of Ph.D. candidacy is the completion of a major research project under the direction of the student’s doctoral advisor(s).

funding.value: Teaching assistantships are competitive; research assistantships depend on faculty grants.
funding.quote: Graduate teaching assistantships are available on a competitive basis | Research assistantships and Cleveland Clinic Fellowships may be available through individual faculty, depending on external funding.

entry_route.value: The page sets prerequisite courses (general, organic, analytical and physical chemistry, physics and calculus) but does not say whether a master's is needed.
entry_route.quote: applicants for graduate study (Master’s and Ph.D.) in chemistry must have had one year of general, organic, analytical, and physical chemistry

notes: Run jointly with the Cleveland Clinic. Prerequisites: one year each of general, organic, analytical and physical chemistry, a year of physics, and calculus through multiple integrals.
name: Ph.D. Clinical-Bioanalytical Chemistry
